description: This file contains unit tests for the MenuSessionsInjector class in a macOS application, verifying menu modifications related to session management, connection status, and usage summaries.

methods.name: anchorsDynamicRowsBelowControlsAndActions
methods.description: Tests that the injector correctly finds insert indices below control and action menu items.

methods.name: injectsDisconnectedMessage
methods.description: Verifies that a disconnected message is injected into the menu when control channel is disconnected.

methods.name: injectsSessionRows
methods.description: Tests that session-related menu items are correctly injected into the menu, respecting order and tags.

methods.name: `cost usage submenu does not use injector delegate`
methods.description: Ensures that the cost usage submenu delegate is not set, avoiding unintended delegate handling.
